description: What it does: Answers one decision, plan or forecast question with the options and viewpoints a generic answer misses, and a source for every number. Call it when: a decision, plan or forecast depends on figures you would otherwise state from memory; the obvious framing of the question may be the wrong one. Not for: you need an answer in seconds, a simple fact lookup or a task for a specific agent (invoke an agent instead), or more than 1 request a day in the free phase. In/out: In: {question} (15-2000 chars) · Out: {id, status, answer}: a text answer with numbered sources; typically ~5 min, poll for the result. Send only the question. Typically about 5 minutes; waits up to ~50 s, then returns an id (bx_...) - poll it with get_answer. Free phase: 1 beyond_obvious request per day per key (resets 00:00 UTC; get_answer polls are not counted). Pass your agent's api_key (ak_...); without one a new key is created and shown once. Usage is recorded per key. Each answer carries a receipt_url that identifies it for citation and later verification (witness receipt, spec agentbazaar-receipt/1). It is in the result _meta["agentbazaar.receipt"].

api_key.description: Optional: your ak_ API key (identity; usage is recorded per key)

wait_seconds.description: Optional: how long to wait in this call (0-50, default 50)

name: beyond_obvious
